Joyce Center]] |champion = |tourney = [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2021–22 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Notre Dame]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Fighting Irish were led by 22nd-year head coach [[Mike Brey]] and played their home games at the [[Edmund P. Joyce Center]] in [[South Bend, Indiana]] as ninth-year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 24–11, 15–5 in [[2021–22 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC Play]] to finish a tie for second place. As the No. 2 seed, they lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to [[2021–22 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 11 seed in the West Region, where they defeated [[2021–22 Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball team|Rutgers]] in the First Four and then upset [[2021–22 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] to advance to the Second Round where they lost to [[2021–22 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, the [[2020–21 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Fighting Irish]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 11–15, 7–11 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in 11th place.{{Cite web|title=2020-21 Notre Dame Fighting Irish Schedule and Results|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/notre-dame/2021-schedule.html|access-date=2021-11-11|website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com|language=en}} In the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] they defeated [[2020–21 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Wake Forest]]{{Cite web|title=Wake Forest vs. Notre Dame - Game Summary - March 9, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401300966|access-date=2021-11-11|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} before losing to [[2020–21 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the second round.{{Cite web|title=Notre Dame vs. North Carolina -
